description: 黑车牺牲插三线，强制白后离位后绝杀
explanation_en: A rook sacrifice interferes on the third rank, forcing the white queen away and opening a mating attack.

intro.popup: 💡 拦截：黑方行动！白后在h3，白象在c3/d3，都在第三横线协同。黑车能牺牲插入g3，切断白方防线后绝杀吗？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Interference: Black to move. White's queen on h3 and bishops on c3 and d3 coordinate along the third rank. Can Black sacrifice a rook on g3 to break the defense and mate?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rg3！车牺牲插入g3，白后必须吃，随后Bh4攻后，Qe3+将杀！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Rg3! sacrifices the rook to interfere on the third rank. After the queen captures, Bh4 attacks it, and Qe3+ leads to mate.

moves.popup: 黑车Rg3！车牺牲插入g3，精确切断白后h3与白象d3在第三横线的联系！
moves.popup_en: Rg3! Black sacrifices the rook on g3, precisely cutting the third-rank connection between White's queen on h3 and bishop on d3.

moves.popup: 白后Qxg3——必须吃车，但白后移到g3，e3将军的路线通了！
moves.popup_en: Qxg3 is forced, but the queen leaves h3 and clears the line for ...Qe3+.

moves.popup: 黑象Bh4！攻击Qg3，逼白后再次移动——步步紧逼！
moves.popup_en: Bh4! The bishop attacks the queen on g3 and forces it to move again, keeping up the pressure.

moves.popup: 白后Qxh4——吃象逃跑，但e3-e2的将杀路线已开！
moves.popup_en: Qxh4 captures the bishop, but the mating route through e3 and e2 is now open.

moves.popup: 黑后Qe3+！将军！白象e2必须拦截——拦截换来绝杀路线！
moves.popup_en: Qe3+! White's bishop must block on e2, and that block opens the mating route.

moves.popup: 白象Be2拦截将军——但黑后紧随而至！
moves.popup_en: The bishop blocks the check on e2, but the black queen follows immediately.

moves.popup: 黑后Qxe2将杀！车牺牲拦截引发的绝杀链——精彩！
moves.popup_en: Qxe2 is checkmate! The rook sacrifice and interference set off a brilliant forced mating sequence.
